abilities.text: Whenever a Pirate you control attacks, choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn —

notes: The second mode's "target creature" is a `choose-objects` pick plus `cant-block` on `that`: an effect inside a family `choose-modes` is never offered a target at cast time (docs/vocabulary/piles-choices.md 5), so the creature is chosen as the trigger resolves.

issues: • Target creature can't block this turn. — expected a TARGET chosen as the triggered ability is put on the stack (CR 603.3d, 601.2c): an opponent's hexproof creature can never be chosen (CR 702.11b), the ability is countered on resolution if the target has become illegal (CR 608.2b), and the mode may not be chosen at all if no legal target exists (CR 700.2d) — scripted choose-objects {chooser:'you', from:{filter:{types:['Creature']}, who:'each-player'}, count:1} followed by cant-block {target:'that', duration:'eot'} — the creature is picked at resolution with no targeting legality check; probe: seat 1's Gladecover Scout (hexproof) was chosen and stopped from blocking. The renderer scores this line 0.29 while the card score reads 1.00. — CR 115.1a, 601.2c, 603.3d, 608.2b, 700.2d, 702.11b

Whenever a Pirate you control attacks, choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn — — expected the mode is chosen as the ability is put onto the stack (CR 700.2a, 601.2b) — scripted the family choose-modes op asks the mode question during resolution (piles-choices.ts ~285-323); family-wide timing divergence, low severity, and the same limitation that forces issue 1 — CR 601.2b, 700.2a
